Animals also play a role in the nitrogen cycle. They eat plants and use the nitrogen to build their own bodies. When animals die, their nitrogen is also released back into the soil. 

The nitrogen cycle is important because it helps keep the right amount of nitrogen in the air, water, and soil. This balance is necessary for plants and animals to live and grow.
